Coulomb's Law and Electric Field Lines

Separation, r
—
Force, F = kQ1Q2 / r2
—
Nature of the force
—
Drag Q1 and Q2 anywhere and watch the field lines and forces change. Drag the small yellow positive charge to explore the field.
  • Like charges repel, unlike charges attract.
  • The bold arrows on each charge show the force it feels: green for attraction, amber for repulsion.
  • The two forces are equal in size and opposite in direction (Newton's third law).
  • The forces grow quickly as the charges get closer: halve r and F becomes four times bigger.
  • Field lines start on positive charges and end on negative charges, or run off to far away. The number of lines drawn is roughly proportional to the size of each charge, and where the lines crowd together the field is stronger.
  • The arrow on the small yellow positive charge shows the direction of the field at that point.
